about: Verification rows for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-lab-Q2: Platt scaling from ingot-dev rowscal (8 prompts of prompts-fn-es x 256 tokens, 1997 samples); cost = wall-clock ms per round measured with ingot-dev gen --spec-rows k (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8; 7 interpolated), 14 GB expert cache, vnax kernels: it includes the wait for the missing experts from the SSD (~5 ms per extra row), which rowscal does not see (it repeats the same round). 16K: the 4K one + 4 ms (estimated, not measured).
